coverage.main: Read all twenty pages of arXiv 1905.11736v5 (NeurIPS 2019): Sections 1-6, Tables 1-6, Figures 1-6, references and the supplementary pages 13-20 (RCE vs CE analysis, GAP comparison Table 1, training-time and kernel-size Figures 2-5, example Figures 7-10).
coverage.supplement: Supplementary material is appended in the arXiv PDF (pp. 13-20) and read.
coverage.excluded_results: White-box starred cells in Tables 4 and 6 and supplement Table 1 (explicitly white-box) are excluded. Table 1 compares method properties. Figures 1, 4-5 and supplement Figures 7-10 are qualitative.

result_groups.locator: Section 5.2 Evaluation Metrics (p. 7); Table 2 (p. 6); Table 4 black-box cells (p. 8); Figure 6 (p. 9); supplement Figures 2-5
result_groups.population: All ImageNet validation images (50k) or ImageNet-NeurIPS (1k, Figure 6); universal generators trained on Paintings/Comics/ImageNet against VGG-16/19, Inc-v3, ResNet-152, applied to every input
result_groups.outcome: fooling rate: percentage of input samples whose predicted label flips after perturbation (also top-1 accuracy in Table 2)
result_groups.evidence: Section 5.2 defines the fooling rate over all input samples, so clean-misclassified inputs and inputs not fooling the source are retained. The outcome is prediction change rather than ground-truth misclassification.

result_groups.population: 50k ImageNet validation images; generators trained against ChexNet (a chest-X-ray DenseNet-121) on Paintings, Comics or ChestX; ImageNet targets
result_groups.evidence: The fooling rate covers all 50k inputs. The ChexNet source has a different label space, so source success on ImageNet inputs is undefined; not coded no.

result_groups.population: 5k ImageNet subset; generators trained against Inc-v3; targets Inc-v3ens3, Inc-v3ens4, IncRes-v2ens
result_groups.outcome: % increase in error rate = adversarial error rate minus clean error rate
result_groups.evidence: Both error rates are computed over all 5k images, with the clean error explicitly subtracted (positive clean-baseline handling); no source-success filtering.

result_groups.population: ImageNet-NeurIPS 1k images; Inc-v3-trained generators versus instance-specific attacks; naturally and adversarially trained targets
result_groups.outcome: 'success rate' (not separately defined; compared against TI results from prior work)
result_groups.evidence: Table 6 reports a success rate without restating whether it is the fooling-rate definition; competitor numbers follow a prior protocol.

f1.evidence: No clean accuracy rows are printed (Gaussian-noise baselines only); Table 5's clean error rates are subtracted but not reported.

f2.evidence: Three scopes explicitly include all inputs (no); the Table 6 success rate is undefined.

f3.evidence: ImageNet-source and Table 5 scopes explicitly retain all inputs (no); the ChexNet-source and Table 6 scopes are unresolved.

f4.evidence: Rates over 50k, 5k or 1k images printed to two decimals (50k) or as differences (Table 5) do not uniquely identify numerators across scopes.

f5.evidence: Every result states an L-infinity budget of 10, 16 or 32 on 0-255 pixels.

f6.evidence: The official repository provides train/eval code, validation image lists and a Google Drive folder of pretrained generators; eval.py reports clean and adversarial accuracy of public torchvision targets. This could supply per-configuration recomputation, but Drive contents and execution were not verified.

artifact_checks.result: Listed via the GitHub API (head 7 July 2021): train.py, eval.py (clean and adversarial accuracy of a target under a chosen generator), generators.py, gaussian_smoothing.py, images.csv, val.txt, saved_models/ReadMe.md; README links a Drive folder of pretrained generators. Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: Fooling rate counts prediction changes; top-1 attacked accuracy is printed without a clean accuracy on the same set. A bound would need recomputed clean accuracy.
Reported values already equal attacked minus clean error on the same 5k images (a nominal bound without max(0, .)); the separate clean error is not printed, so no further extraction.
Metric definition and clean baseline unstated.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. Table 5's clean-error subtraction is noted for the manuscript alongside rank 32's feature-denoising adjustment.
